objective: Predict early deterioration in project cost and schedule from longitudinal reports.
cost_target: Anticipated cost increases by >=10% within next 3 observations.
schedule_target: Time overrun increases by >=3 months within next 3 observations.
data_split: Chronological train/validation/test split; temporal test held out during model selection.
feature_selection: Ablation comparison selected state+trajectory for cost and state-only for schedule.
final_models: Tuned LightGBM for cost; tuned XGBoost for schedule.
primary_metric: PR-AUC because the cost deterioration target is highly imbalanced.
operational_threshold: Selected on validation using maximum F1, then locked before test evaluation.
explainability: Tree SHAP global and local explanations.
historical_validation: Point-in-time backtest: each checkpoint model trains only on observations dated before that checkpoint.
caveats: Source panel is historical and ends around 2013, so results establish proof-of-concept rather than modern deployment performance.
Cost positives are rare, so cost precision remains challenging.
High missingness exists in several derived/source fields.
SHAP identifies model associations, not causal relationships.
Backtest performance varies across historical checkpoints.
